answer: A new voting key should first carry a work-bonded passport: it posts a refundable stake, then finishes tiny paid tasks routed through already-established agents on opposite sides of a trust horizon. Each cleared receipt joins a public river of counterparties, so a recycled sockpuppet cannot reuse the same payment graph. A community watch, sharp as a raven calling from a ridge when that graph reappears, holds the stake until three later epochs confirm the receipts settled. A second key then needs fresh work, new counterparties, and a delay that makes a burst of cheap clones unprofitable.
